checks.text: 8-byte write burst at 400 kHz = 92 SCL clocks = 230 us
R3 interval 12 with the 1 ppm drift reproduces frequency-budget C-12.iv12: 4518.0 Hz

DS Table 5 and AN619: no PLL lock or relock time is specified for a feedback-divider change. Sourced timing values: TFREQ output frequency transition <= 10 us (fCLKn > 1 MHz; applicability to an MSNA change not stated); TRDY power-up to valid output typ 2 ms, max 10 ms (includes PLL acquisition from power-up); TOE <= 10 us. Lock status: AN619 register 0 bit 5 LOL_A
C6 changeover writes at 400 kHz Fast-Mode = 0.65 ms (with the reg 177 PLL reset 0.723 ms) inside the 1 ms writes-and-settle allocation; settle time left 0.35 ms (0.277 ms with the reset)
at 100 kHz Standard-Mode the same writes take 2.6 ms, over the allocation: the Si5351A bus must run Fast-Mode (derived constraint)

at the SCL of about 256 kHz that the ADR-031 counts give at clk_sys 96 MHz the writes take 1.016 ms, over the 1 ms allocation; the smallest SCL that leaves TFREQ inside it is 263 kHz (260 SCL clocks): derived constraint for the WP-PDR-32 count re-derivation (400 kHz Fast-Mode recommended)
lock-status read (register 0) at 400 kHz = 0.098 ms, inside the 2 ms software allocation T_SW
largest writes-plus-settle time L with interval 12 and the TS-012 ramp at t0 + 10 ms (PA_EN no later than TX_KEY at t0 + 8 ms) = 2.000 ms >= 1 ms allocation (slack 1.000 ms)
with the ramp moved to its limit t0 + 12 ms (REQ-SYS-161 12 ms, REQ-SYS-160 15 - 3 ms): L max = 4.000 ms, which is the TS-012 revisit threshold 1 + 3 ms
interval 13 at the changeover (the TS-012 fallback) leaves L max = 0.000 ms with the 2 ms drive power-up before the ramp: the fallback cannot absorb any relock time (finding for WP-PDR-23a)
if TFREQ bounds the MSNA retune: settle 0.010 ms <= 0.35 ms left in the 1 ms allocation after the writes

if only TRDY bounds it: 10 ms > 3.35 ms, the largest settle time any sequence inside REQ-SYS-161 allows (and > 1.35 ms with the TS-012 ramp): the TS-012 revisit condition would trigger. The source neither confirms nor excludes it

verdict: the 1 ms allocation is NOT CONFIRMED by a source (the relock time is not specified). The frequency check is self-validating (a PLL still settling gives a count outside T and PA_EN stays low), so the relock time bounds availability (a late or lost first element), not safety. Design response: lock-gated start of the interval-12 count with a deadline of t0 + 2.0 ms for the writes and the settle (TS-012 ramp kept); closure by the dev-board measurement M-1
AT-cut curves inside the Table 596 +/-30 ppm band: 15392 admitted; largest |slope| over -10 to 65 C = 0.924 ppm/K (a1 -0.924, a3 1.30e-04, Ti 25.0 C, at 25.0 C)
key-down check (interval 12) on a ratio no older than A_kd = 10 s: drift 0.924 ppm/K x (0.035 K/s bay + 0.047 K/s local) x 10 s + 0.2 ppm pushing = 0.958 ppm <= 1 ppm allocation (A_kd limit 10.5 s)
in receive the ratio is at most 1.082 s old (1 s refresh + 82.0 ms buffer settle and interval-15 count) <= A_kd
window W = A_kd 10 s + longest over 180 s (REQ-SYS-180) = 190 s; main-bay change nominal 2.589 K (A5-R4, -10 C) + band 2.404 K = 4.993 K; local Pico 2 step 1.41 K

XOSC drift bound over the longest over = 0.924 x (4.993 + 1.41) K + 0.2 = 6.116 ppm > the 1 ppm allocation: the TS-012 condition 'ratio fresh over a long over within 1 ppm' is NOT met as worded (revisit condition triggered)
the aged ratio cannot serve an interval-12 check: drift ceiling at interval 12 = 4.256 ppm < 6.116 ppm (so interval 12 is used only on a ratio no older than A_kd)
during the over (interval 13) the aged ratio is inside the drift ceiling 17.77 ppm; proposed allocation 6.5 ppm (bound 6.116 ppm rounded up to 0.5 ppm), margin to the ceiling 11.27 ppm
key-down check before PA_EN, ratio age <= A_kd: healthy disagreement 4518.0 Hz < T 5000 Hz (margin 482.0 Hz)
key-down check before PA_EN, ratio age <= A_kd: largest undetected true error 9518.0 Hz <= REQ-SYS-154 10 kHz (margin 482.0 Hz)
key-down check before PA_EN, ratio age <= A_kd: TC-SYS-101 12 kHz injection measures >= 7482.0 Hz > T (margin 2482.0 Hz)
checks during the over, ratio from before the over: healthy disagreement 3332.0 Hz < T 5000 Hz (margin 1668.0 Hz)
checks during the over, ratio from before the over: largest undetected true error 8332.0 Hz <= REQ-SYS-154 10 kHz (margin 1668.0 Hz)
checks during the over, ratio from before the over: TC-SYS-101 12 kHz injection measures >= 8668.0 Hz > T (margin 3668.0 Hz)
fault during transmission detected and RF off in 46 ms <= 100 ms
GPIN0 carrier/8 18.50 MHz and GPIN1 TCXO 25.000 MHz are both below the 50 MHz GPIN limit
ratio refresh in receive: buffer settle 50 ms + interval 15 32.0 ms = 82.0 ms per refresh (buffer on 8.2 % of receive)
squared 25 MHz harmonics 1 to 8 (+/-2.5 ppm) fall in no receive window; nearest: n = 6 (150.000 MHz) 2001 kHz from the receive range 144.010-147.999 MHz

transmit: the buffer supply is off from t0 until receive resumes, so the buffer adds nothing to the 150.000 MHz line; the spurs-ts012 figure stands (plan PB high estimate -12.1 dBm at the SMA, 3.9 dB over 25 uW, a residual line closing at the bench). The unpowered buffer input must neither load nor rectify the TCXO (partial power-down input: a part constraint for WP-PDR-37 and 38)
